title: Form controls starter pack
summary: Every official form control in one package: chart, saved report, address search, map, signature, rating, slider, rich text, table, survey and more.
description:
Install the whole set of official UserTasks form controls at once. Each control lands in Extensibility → Form controls, enabled, and appears in the form designer's Custom palette, ready to drag onto a form.

The pack carries the controls only. The address search control needs a lookup source on the field (the single Address search package also ships the Google Places integration, API reference and a sample form), the map needs an administrator to approve its tile hosts, and the saved report and chart controls need a report chosen in the designer. Every other control works as soon as it is installed.

changelog.notes: Dynamic properties: chart data, map markers (new), Likert statements, table rows, info card text, rating max, progress and slider values can be bound to an expression, a data table or an API reference in the form designer.
All thirteen controls at 1.1.0: declared workflow outputs (rich text, address, map and chart reach workflows as text, with the full value under <key>_raw) and no visible loading on forms.
